# graylog_pipeline_rule (Data Source)

Retrieves a single Graylog pipeline rule by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graylog_pipeline_rule" "example" {
  id = "existing-rule-id"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The pipeline rule ID.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `modified_at` (String)
- `source` (String)
- `title` (String)
